description.en: Roughly contiguous city territories east of the Jordan from Damascus to Philadelphia (Amman), plus Scythopolis (Beth Shean) west of the river.
description.ar: أراضي مدن متصلة تقريبًا شرق الأردن من دمشق إلى فيلادلفيا (عمّان)، إضافة إلى سكيثوبوليس (بيسان) غرب النهر.
description.he: שטחי ערים רצופים בערך ממזרח לירדן מדמשק עד פילדלפיה (עמאן), בתוספת סקיתופוליס (בית שאן) ממערב לנהר.

sources.quote: All these cities, except Scythopolis, are located east of the Jordan River, extending from Damascus in the north to Philadelphia in the south.
All these Pompey left in a state of freedom, and joined them to the province of Syria.
All the towns except Scythopolis lie in the region east of the Jordan.
